_about: Config for the career-engine pipeline. 'database_backend' names your tracker (default 'notion'). REQUIRED keys (a run stops without them): output_folder, cv_template, and database_id (only when a database backend is configured). EVERY other key is OPTIONAL — pipelines run without it and a config-health notice lists what is empty or missing, so an older config never breaks. View URL keys (database_*_view_url) are optional fast-paths: when present, the pipeline skips the 59KB Notion database discovery fetch and queries the view directly. Legacy names (notion_database_id, notion_needs_editing_view_url, notion_property, idea_bank.notion_database_id, idea_bank.notion_page_url) are still read for backward compatibility; prefer the database_* names.

screening_answers.description: Your standing answers to common screening questions. Intake flags a conflict OR confirms a match in Patterns; sourcing down-ranks a conflicting role with a visible label. Free text; leave any field blank to skip it (e.g. travel: 'open to frequent travel' or 'prefer minimal travel').

idea_bank.description: Database for idea capture (mind-dump pipeline). Set database_id to your Ideas database ID.

linkedin_post.description: LinkedIn post writing pipeline config. default_format_mix is advisory for the content orchestrator.

content_calendar.description: Content calendar orchestrator config. default_batch_size is the number of posts per orchestrator run.

pricing_floors.description: Your minimum prices (the agent never quotes below these in copy). fiverr_basic/standard/premium are the three Fiverr gig-tier floors; upwork_hourly is your Upwork hourly-rate floor (net — list rate is this divided by 0.8 to absorb Upwork's 20% cut). Leave any field blank to skip it.

freelance.description: Freelance-manager config (Fiverr + Upwork). fiverr_username, upwork_profile_url, and brand_name are platform handles; pricing_floors holds your minimum prices. All optional — the freelance-manager asks inline for anything blank.
